name: Electric Vehicle Motor Systems
summary:
Electric Vehicle Motor Systems is an immersive VR training application developed to help learners understand the core components, functionality, and diagnostics of electric vehicle motor systems. Through interactive simulations, users gain practical experience with motor assemblies, controllers, and troubleshooting procedures in a safe, virtual environment.

This application is exclusively designed as a part of the Immerse Learn Electric Vehicle Motor Systems micro-credential program. It is not a standalone
